fields.name: bias_types
fields.definition: Social bias types explicitly discussed in relation to LLMs or generative AI systems, whether empirically observed or described as potential risks.

fields.name: se_tasks_or_contexts
fields.definition: Software Engineering tasks or generative AI software pipeline contexts explicitly connected to bias or fairness, whether studied empirically or discussed as intended applications.
fields.unit_of_extraction: One distinct Software Engineering task or socio-technical context

fields.name: llm_systems
fields.definition: LLMs, assistants or generative systems evaluated as subjects of the bias analysis.
fields.unit_of_extraction: One distinct LLM, assistant or generative system

fields.name: bias_sources
fields.definition: Sources or origins of bias asserted or hypothesized by the study authors.
fields.unit_of_extraction: One distinct source or origin of bias

fields.name: evaluation_methods
fields.definition: Methods, datasets and measurements proposed or used to detect or evaluate bias; preserve whether they are proposed or actually used.
fields.unit_of_extraction: One distinct evaluation method, dataset or measurement

fields.name: reported_impacts
fields.definition: Consequences of bias explicitly described by the authors, including potential harms and background claims as well as observed effects.
fields.unit_of_extraction: One distinct impact or consequence of bias

fields.name: manifestations
fields.definition: Specific forms of bias explicitly described in outputs, data or behavior, whether observed or discussed as potential problems; identify the form of bias rather than only where it occurs.
fields.unit_of_extraction: One distinct concrete manifestation of bias in outputs or behavior

fields.name: mitigation_strategies
fields.definition: Bias mitigation strategies proposed, implemented or empirically tested by the study.
